title: Linear Risk Sharing in Community-Based Insurance: Ruin Reduction in the Compound Poisson Model
abstract: arXiv:2603.29530v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper studies proportional risk sharing at claim occurrence time in community-based insurance. Each participant is modeled by an individual Cram\'er-Lundberg surplus process, and, whenever a claim is reported within the pool, its cost is redistributed according to a fixed allocation matrix. We compare the infinite-time ruin probability of each participant under stand-alone operation and under pool participation. Our main result shows that pooling reduces, for every participant, the infinite-time ruin probability when claim severities belong to a common scale family, the allocation rule satisfies full allocation and actuarial fairness, and each transfer remains bounded by an individual capacity condition. The proof relies on a convex-order comparison between the losses borne inside the pool and the corresponding stand-alone losses. translated_title: 社区保险中的线性风险分担：复合泊松模型中的破产概率降低
translated_abstract: 本文研究社区保险中理赔发生时刻的比例风险分担机制。每位参与者由一个独立的Cramér-Lundberg盈余过程建模，当保险池内有理赔被报告时，其成本按照一个固定的分配矩阵进行重新分配。我们比较了每位参与者在独立运营与加入保险池两种情形下的无穷时间破产概率。我们的主要结果表明：当理赔损失额属于同一尺度族、分配规则满足完全分配和精算公平、且每次转移金额受个体容量条件约束时，加入保险池能够降低每位参与者的无穷时间破产概率。证明依赖于对池内承担的损失与相应独立损失之间的凸序比较。我们还阐明了这些假设的作用，展示了在此框架之外，加入保险池（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明在理赔损失属于同一尺度族、分配规则满足完全分配与精算公平、且每次转移受个体容量条件约束时，社区保险池中的线性比例风险分担能够降低每位参与者的无穷时间破产概率。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that linear proportional risk sharing in a community insurance pool reduces every participant's infinite-time ruin probability, provided claim severities belong to a common scale family, the allocation rule satisfies full allocation and actuarial fairness, and each transfer is bounded by an individual capacity condition.
